GovernancePolicy.Name: AI Governance Gateway Policy
GovernancePolicy.FrameworkProfile: NIST AI RMF 1.0, NIST AI 600-1, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, OWASP LLM Top 10 2025, NIST CSF 2.0, and EU AI Act GPAI support mapping.
GovernancePolicy.RiskAppetite: Allow low-risk AI requests, route medium/high-risk requests to human review, and block critical harmful, illegal, cyber-abuse, or globally banned content before model invocation.

Controls.Description: Policy, ownership, risk appetite, and framework mappings are externalized in JSON configuration.
AI risks are categorized and connected to relevant framework references.
Requests and responses are checked for harmful, biased, sensitive, prompt-injection, cyber-abuse, and regulated categories.
Policy thresholds decide allow, block, or human review before AI model access.
Every pipeline decision is logged by correlation id for traceability and review.
